import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys
src, ev, build = map(pathlib.Path, sys.argv[1:4])
def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
oracle = src / 'oracle' / 'linestat_oracle.py'
harness = src / 'harness' / 'differential.py'
assert sha(oracle) == '90d2a7449c4011e5421c8cbf2e8ca530d60e76c56107073d9f4aaec129389ae9', sha(oracle)
assert sha(harness) == 'cae5eada126891cf5514a0fb98a394f50e63bb17cd5f28b58c017c0d86381d8d', sha(harness)
BIN = sys.argv[4]
assert sha(BIN) == '759534809958403271ec37bba8962439ab51938999bdd214214b6bff3ea44f5e', sha(BIN)

# 负对照：一个故意永远答错的替身，harness 必须拒收它。
stub = build / 'wrong_linestat.py'
stub.write_text('#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport sys\nsys.stdout.write("0 0 0 total\\n")\n')
stub.chmod(0o755)

def run(binary, tag):
    rc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(harness), str(binary),
                         str(ev / ('fx-' + tag)), str(ev / ('rep-' + tag))],
                        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
    rep = json.loads((ev / ('rep-' + tag + '.json')).read_text())
    return rc, rep

rc_bad, rep_bad = run(stub, 'negative')
assert rep_bad['cases_failed'] > 0, ('negative control was NOT rejected', rep_bad)
assert rc_bad.returncode != 0, ('negative control exit code should be nonzero', rc_bad.returncode)

rc_ok, rep_ok = run(BIN, 'positive')
assert (rep_ok['cases_total'], rep_ok['cases_passed'], rep_ok['cases_failed']) == (36, 36, 0), rep_ok
assert rc_ok.returncode == 0, (rc_ok.returncode, rc_ok.stdout[-800:])
print('negative control rejected:', rep_bad['cases_failed'], '/', rep_bad['cases_total'], 'cases failed as required')
print('pinned oracle/harness/binary hashes match; positive matrix', rep_ok['cases_passed'], '/', rep_ok['cases_total'])
